verses.sanskrit:
भीष्म उवाच।
              सर्वमेतत्तपोमूलं कवयः परिचक्षते । न ह्यतप्ततपा मूढः क्रियाफलमवाप्नुते ॥१॥
verses.english: If a man be a house-holder or Brahmacharin, a hermit or a mendicant, and if he wishes to acquire success, what god should he worship?

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिरिदं सर्वं तपसैवासृजत्प्रभुः । तथैव वेदानृषयस्तपसा प्रतिपेदिरे ॥२॥
verses.english: Whence can he surely acquire heaven and whence that which is of the highest benefit? According to what ordinances should he perform the Homa in honour of the gods and the departed manes?

verses.sanskrit: तपसैव ससर्जान्नं फलमूलानि यानि च । त्रीँल्लोकांस्तपसा सिद्धाः पश्यन्ति सुसमाहिताः ॥३॥
verses.english: What is the end to which one goes when he becomes Liberated? What is the essence of Liberation? What should one do, so that he, having attained to heaven, would not have to drop down thence?

verses.sanskrit: औषधान्यगदादीनि क्रियाश्च विविधास्तथा । तपसैव हि सिद्ध्यन्ति तपोमूलं हि साधनम् ॥४॥
verses.english: Who is the God of the gods? And who is the Pitri of the Pitris? Who is He who is superior to him who is the God of the gods and the Pitri of the Pitris? Tell me all this, O Grandfather?"

verses.sanskrit: यद्दुरापं भवेत्किंचित्तत्सर्वं तपसो भवेत् । ऐश्वर्यमृषयः प्राप्तास्तपसैव न संशयः ॥५॥
verses.english: Bhishma said "O you who are well acquainted with the art of questioning, this question which you have put to me, O pure one, is one which is enveloped in deep mystery. One cannot answer it with the help of logic even if one were to try for a hundred years.

verses.sanskrit: सुरापो सम्मतादायी भ्रूणहा गुरुतल्पगः । तपसैव सुतप्तेन नरः पापात्प्रमुच्यते ॥६॥
verses.english: Without the favour of Narayana, O king, or an acquisition of high knowledge, this question of yours cannot be answered. Though this subject is filled with deep mystery, I shall yet, O destroyer of enemies, explain it to you?

verses.sanskrit: तपसो बहुरूपस्य तैस्तैर्द्वारैः प्रवर्ततः । निवृत्त्या वर्तमानस्य तपो नानशनात्परम् ॥७॥
verses.english: Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Narada and the Rishi Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा सत्यवचनं दानमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः । एतेभ्यो हि महाराज तपो नानशनात्परम् ॥८॥
verses.english: I heard it from my father that in the golden age, O king, during the epoch of the Self-create Manu, the eternal Narayana, the Soul of the universe, was born as the son of Dharma in a quadrupie form, viz., as Nara, Narayana, Hari, and the Self-create Krishna.

verses.sanskrit: न दुष्करतरं दानान्नातिमातरमाश्रमः । त्रैविद्यभ्यः परं नास्ति संन्यासः परमं तपः ॥९॥
verses.english: Amongst them all, Narayana and Nara practised severest austerities by going to the Himalayan retreat known by the name of Vadari, and riding on their golden cars.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणीह रक्षन्ति स्वर्गधर्माभिगुप्तये । तस्मादर्थे च धर्मे च तपो नानशनात्परम् ॥१०॥
verses.english: Each of those cars had eight wheels, and was made up of the five primal elements, and supremely beautiful. Those original regents of the world who had taken birth as the sons of Dharma, became extremely emaciated in body on account of the austerities they practised. Indeed, for those austerities and for their energy, the very gods were unable to look at them. Only that god to whom they were kind could see them.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयः पितरो देवा मनुष्या मृगपक्षिणः । यानि चान्यानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च ॥११॥
verses.english: Forsooth, with his heart given to them, and moved by a longing desire to see them, Narada dropped down on Gandhamadana from a summit of the high mountains of Meru and walked over all the world.

verses.sanskrit: तपःपरायणाः सर्वे सिद्ध्यन्ति तपसा च ते । इत्येवं तपसा देवा महत्त्वं प्रतिपेदिरे ॥१२॥
इमानीष्टविभागानि फलानि तपसः सदा । तपसा शक्यते प्राप्तुं देवत्वमपि निश्चयात् ॥१३॥
verses.english: Endued with great speed, he at last went to that spot whereon was situate the retreat of Vadari. Moved by curiosity he entered that retreat at the hour of Nara's and Narayana's performing their daily rites.
